transcript: Speaker A: India mein 90% log English isiliye nahi bol paate kyunki unke aas-paas mahaul Hindi wala hota hai. Aas-paas English mein baat karne wala koi nahi hota. Aur agar koi English mein baat karne ka try kare, toh sab log uska mazak udaane lagte hain. Ab aap hi bataiye, kaise seekh payega koi English bolna? Chaliye aap log rehne dijiye, main hi batata hoon - English Seekho App. Ji haan, English Seekho App ka AI coach daily bina aapko judge kiye aapke saath English mein baat karne ke liye available rahega. English Seekho App ke AI coach ke saath aap 24 ghanton mein kabhi bhi English mein baat kar sakte hain. Woh coach aapki galat English ka kabhi mazak nahi banayega, balki aapko hamesha correct karega. English Seekho App ke AI coach ke saath befikar, bina dar, kuch hi dino mein farratedar English bolne lagenge. Toh ab agar Hindi ke mahaul mein rehkar apni English ko farratedar banana hai, toh abhi download kijiye English Seekho App. [In India, 90% of people cannot speak English because their surrounding environment is Hindi-speaking, with no one to practice with. If anyone tries, people mock them. How can anyone learn? Let me tell you about the English Seekho App. Its AI coach is available 24/7 to practice English with you without judging. It will never mock your mistakes but will always correct you, helping you speak fluent English fearlessly in a few days. Download the app now to speak fluent English.] Speaker B: Toh install button pe click karo aur English Seekho App download karo. [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho App.]

He introduces the English Seekho App, highlighting its 24/7 non-judgmental AI coach that corrects mistakes to build fluency. The ad concludes with a call to action to install the app.
